changes.evidence: The Leviathan stage is keyed to the whole show 'Agent Carter', but the record uses seasons (Independent at 'Agent Carter S2'). Dottie serves Leviathan in season 1 (Fennhoff's V-E Day plot, from episode 6). After that she goes freelance, and in season 2 she is hired to rob a bank, as the record already has it. So the stage belongs to 'Agent Carter S1'.

Ward's return to HYDRA happens on screen in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2 episode 22 (episode 44 overall, 'S.O.S. Part Two'). In a Boston bar he takes charge of HYDRA thugs ('Hail Hydra to that'), says he is 'done flying solo', and orders them to find more names so he can rebuild HYDRA. Season 3 only shows him already running it. The last stage should be keyed to S2, not S3. The left at S2 stays: in S2 episode 10 he turns on Whitehall's HYDRA.

In Madame Web, Ben Parker works as Cassie's paramedic partner (an FDNY EMT) and revives her on that job. His employer is a group under the owner's rules, and the dataset already has the group name 'FDNY' (A:grills).

owner_calls.question: In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7, the record's own step has Coulson's Chronicom LMD (same memories) serving as Mack's second-in-command in S.H.I.E.L.D., then taking a 'sabbatical' to see the world in the finale. The record ends 'Independent' at S5 (he retires to Tahiti). Should the LMD's S7 service count on this record?
options: Keep as is: the LMD is a new being, and the real Coulson's group story ends at his S5 retirement
Add ['S.H.I.E.L.D.', 'Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7'] as the last stage (a sabbatical is not a departure)
Add S.H.I.E.L.D. at S7 and also a left at S7 for the sabbatical
owner_calls.evidence: S7 episode 1 on: Simmons presents the Chronicom LMD Coulson to Mack as his right hand. MCU wiki gives the LMD's title as Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. and its affiliation as S.H.I.E.L.D. In episode 13 he 'decided to take a sabbatical from S.H.I.E.L.D. to see the world'.

owner_calls.question: In Luke Cage S1 the record has Zip leave the Stokes Crime Family for 'Independent'. In episode 12, Turk Barrett tells Zip he has 'turned against the Stokes Crime Family and instead joined Diamondback's crew', and Zip tries to kill Shades on Diamondback's orders. But the dataset files Diamondback himself in the Stokes Crime Family. How should Zip's last stage read?
options: Keep as is (Independent, left Luke Cage S1)
Remove the Independent stage and the left: Diamondback leads the Stokes Crime Family, so Zip never left it
Replace Independent with a group for Diamondback's crew (the screen only says 'Diamondback's crew')
owner_calls.evidence: S1 episode 8: Shades takes over Zip's crew for the Stokes family. Episodes 9 to 12: Zip serves Diamondback. Episode 12: Barrett's line about turning on the family, then Shades kills Zip.
